definitions.explanation: A device or software for creating text documents.

notes:
ワープロ is an abbreviation of ⟦ワード→ワード：30523_waado⟧プロセッサー (word processor).

ETYMOLOGY:
In the 1980s-90s, dedicated word processor machines were extremely popular in Japan. These standalone devices were specifically designed for Japanese text input and document creation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ワープロ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to type on a word processor
- ワープロ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧: word-processed document
- ワープロ⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧: word processor certification exam

USAGE:
Now somewhat dated as ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧ (personal computer) has replaced dedicated word processors. Still used to refer to word processing software, though ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧ is more precise.
